{{Quote|Welcome back to Republic news. I'm your host, Alec Ranin.|Ranin as his broadcast starts|<ref name="HeartsAndMinds" />}}
'''Alec Ranin''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Journalist/Legends|news reporter]] within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for a [[Republic News Network]] based out of [[Carrick Station]]. In the year [[3627 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|5.10.3}}</ref> he contacted the [[Alliance Commander]] and interviewed them on his show.<ref name="HeartsAndMinds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alec Ranin appears during the quest "Hearts and Minds" for Republic Players, where he requests an interview with the player after their decision to align the [[Eternal Alliance]] with the Republic. The player can give a number of answers to his questions during the interview, where they can either speak enthusiastically or negatively about the Republic and their chances of defeating the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the recently returned [[Darth Malgus]].<ref name="HeartsAndMinds" />
